item.description:
• A new welcome screen on first launch helps you allow Screen Recording before your first rampage
  • Rampages now start only on the screen under your mouse pointer, with a single countdown

• Earn Scrap from every rampage and spend it in the new Arsenal
  • Unlock four new weapons: grenade, shuriken, energy wave, and nuke
  • Unlock comic-style hit words and fire in blue, green, or purple
  • Unlock confetti explosions and slow motion on big combos
  • See a score card when a rampage ends, then copy, save, or share it

• Freeze your screen into a picture and wreck it with nine weapons
  • Pistol, minigun, bazooka, flamethrower, laser, freeze ray, Tesla coil, black hole, and sword
  • Mix weapons to shatter ice, make steam, and chain lightning through fire
  • Count down 3, 2, 1, then chase combos, ranks, and trophies
  • Repair everything in one sweep, or save a picture of the wreckage
  • Sound, screen shake, and debris you can tune
  • Nothing real gets touched, and nothing leaves your Mac
